name: Thunderball
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small bell)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A thunderball spell generates a thunderous explosion of sound that detonates and deals 1d4 points of sonic damage per caster level (maximum 10d4) to every creature within the area. Unattended objects also take this damage. The explosion creates almost no pressure.

You point your finger and determine the range (distance and height) at which the thunderball is to burst. A glowing, pea-sized bead streaks from the pointing digit and, unless it impacts upon a material body or solid barrier prior to attaining the prescribed range, bursts into the thunderball at that point. An early impact results in an early detonation. If you attempt to send the bead through a narrow passage, such as through an arrow slit, you must “hit” the opening with a ranged touch attack, or else the bead strikes the barrier and detonates prematurely.

The thunderball damages objects in the area. If the damage caused to an interposing barrier shatters or breaks through it, the thunderball may continue beyond the barrier if the area permits; otherwise it stops at the barrier just as any other spell effect does.

A thunderball does not function in an area of silence. If the center of the burst is in the area, the spell fails.
